+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+SCRIPTS = ROOT / "scripts"
+if str(SCRIPTS) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))
+
+import hive_node_registry as target
+
+import pytest
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from hive_node_registry import timestamp_age_seconds
+
+
+def test_timestamp_age_seconds_empty_string():
+    assert timestamp_age_seconds("") is None
+
+
+def test_timestamp_age_seconds_naive_timestamp_returns_none():
+    naive = "2024-01-01T12:00:00"
+    result = timestamp_age_seconds(naive)
+    assert result is None
+
+
+def test_timestamp_age_seconds_future_by_5_seconds_returns_none():
+    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+    future_5s = now.replace(":00", ":05")
+    result = timestamp_age_seconds(future_5s)
+    assert result is None
+
+
+def test_timestamp_age_seconds_utc_z_timestamp():
+    utc_z = "2024-01-01T12:00:00Z"
+    result = timestamp_age_seconds(utc_z)
+    assert isinstance(result, float)
+    assert result >= 0.0
+
+
+def test_timestamp_age_seconds_explicit_utc_offset():
+    utc_offset = "2024-01-01T12:00:00+00:00"
+    result = timestamp_age_seconds(utc_offset)
+    assert isinstance(result, float)
+    assert result >= 0.0
+
+
+def test_timestamp_age_seconds_future_timestamp_clamped_to_zero():
+    future = "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"
+    result = timestamp_age_seconds(future)
+    assert result == 0.0
+
+
+def test_timestamp_age_seconds_recent_past_timestamp():
+    past = "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
+    result = timestamp_age_seconds(past)
+    assert isinstance(result, float)
+    assert result > 0.0
